items.title: The Figma agent is now available in FigJam and Slides
items.excerpt: Figma extends its AI agent beyond Figma Design into FigJam and Slides, so it can help explore ideas on the whiteboard, prepare meetings and build presentations from design work.

history_match.title: Generate multiple images from a single prompt

items.title: Framer adds Automations, Connectors and a Slack Agent to its design agent
items.excerpt: Framer's new Automations are agent workflows that run on a schedule or on project events like publishing or form submissions; Connectors let the Framer agent read and act in Slack, Notion and Ahrefs, and a Slack Agent can query the site, check analytics or make quick edits from Slack.

history_match.title: IronCAD 2027 update adds design automation tools

items.title: 5 Best Claude Skills for Designers in 2026
items.excerpt: Builder.io lists five Claude skills it uses for design work with exact commands: Impeccable for UI polish, /remix for inspiration and Emil Kowalski's skill for motion.

history_match.title: Impeccable: The Open-Source Design Skill That Stops AI Websites Looking AI-Generated

items.title: How to reverse engineer a website with AI
items.excerpt: A walkthrough of finding the element that draws a site's UI, taking it apart in Builder's Agent-Native Design and rebuilding it in your own brand with an AI agent.

items.title: 30% more code, zero more finished work. Design is next
items.excerpt: Citing a Harvard finding that AI coding agents added 30% more code but no more finished work, the author argues design review is the next bottleneck and how teams should prepare.

items.title: Anthropic turns Claude Artifacts into standalone desktop apps for macOS and Windows
items.excerpt: Claude Artifacts can now be installed as beta desktop apps on Mac and Windows, even with a free account; built in chat without code, they can use OS APIs and connectors to add menu bar items, notifications and transparent windows.

history_match.title: Google's Gemini can now run Mac apps and finish desktop chores in the background

items.title: Anthropic tops 700 million monthly MCP SDK downloads and expands the protocol for more autonomous AI agents
items.excerpt: Two years after launch, MCP passes 700 million monthly SDK downloads; new protocol features such as background tasks, follow-up questions to users and file uploads let agents work more independently across tools.

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
items.excerpt: GPT-6.2 Sol becomes ChatGPT's default chat model worldwide; OpenAI says internal image-understanding scores jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent and difficult instructions are handled correctly 78.1 percent of the time.

history_match.title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs

items.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
items.excerpt: The NYT told its photographers to hold off on a Photoshop update because it does not want AI metadata inadvertently attached to its news photos.

items.title: Ally Financial reinvents customer personas with agentic AI
items.excerpt: Ally's designers pick from six agentic AI personas built from profiles of its 11 million-plus customers, add modifiers, and get real-time feedback on digital products before human testing.

items.title: Figma-first vs Code-first Product Design: When to Use Each
items.excerpt: Because AI coding tools like Claude Code make exploring interfaces in code cheap, Eleken argues designers should test directions in code and refine in Figma, switching as the problem changes.

history_match.title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would

items.title: Prototypes have always been the most effective specification - especially with AI
items.excerpt: When building a working version costs an afternoon with AI, the prototype replaces the requirements document as the spec teams review.

items.title: The attack of the giant AI design slop monster: a survivor's guide
items.excerpt: Expanded from a talk at City St George's HCI Design conference, a guide to how AI has reshaped UX design in 2026 and how designers can push back against generic AI-generated output.

items.title: Discover BOT VFX's hybrid AI VFX pipeline for Young Washington
items.excerpt: BOT VFX explains how it blended AI models such as FLUX.2 Klein and Wan, including FLUX-based inpainting, with a traditional Maya-Nuke pipeline for the historical drama Young Washington.

items.title: See what 5 builders are making with Gemini 4 Neon
items.excerpt: Builders used Gemini 4 Neon, mostly in Google Antigravity, to make a glowing 3D Earth, Three.js butterflies, a hexagon flame shader, an interactive 3D black hole and a pendulum wave simulation.

items.title: Independent filmmakers in India bring big-screen stories to life with Google Flow
items.excerpt: Five winning short films from the Women in Film India Filmathon were made with Google Flow, Google's AI filmmaking tool.

history_match.title: 5 new Google Flow Tools designed by visual artists

items.title: Cognitive Design 2.3 marks CDS newest release
items.excerpt: Cognitive Design Systems' AI engineering software adds automated Design of Experiments and a Design Explorer: it sweeps parameter ranges, generates each variant and scores it on structural, manufacturing, cost and CO2 criteria.

items.title: GPT-4o vs Claude 3.5 vs Sonnet 4 vs LLaVA 7B: 480 Color Tests Reveal AI Blue
items.excerpt: Four vision LLMs rated 40 named colors across 480 observations; pastels and mid-tones broke everywhere, which the author links to why AI-generated UIs drift blue. Dataset is on Zenodo.

items.title: A palette is not a design: our AI Extension Builder now reads what our designers wrote
items.excerpt: GoodBarber's AI Extension Builder now reads designers' written design intent, not just an app's color palette, when generating extensions that match an app's design.

items.title: Google's Project Genie Turns Text Into Worlds
items.excerpt: The AI Advantage short demos Google DeepMind's Project Genie world model generating explorable worlds from text prompts.
